name: Schoolgirl Saga
source:
You, as a professor/counselor must deal with (and influence) the strange lives of students (including your niece) at the school/university. You've also struck a questionable deal with a sinister cult.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/sagas]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演教授兼辅导员，处理并影响学校或大学里学生（包括侄女）的奇怪生活。你还与一个险恶邪教达成了可疑协议。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/sagas]Patreon[/url]]
